```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
```

## Tastk 1: Load and Clean Faculty Salaries Data

```{r}
faculty <- read_csv("FacultySalaries_1995.csv")

glimpse(faculty)
```

```{r}
faculty_tidy <- faculty %>%
  select(State, Tier,
         AvgFullProfSalary,
         AvgAssocProfSalary,
         AvgAssistProfSalary) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Avg"),
    names_to = "Rank",
    values_to = "Salary"
  )

faculty_tidy <- faculty_tidy %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = case_when(
      Rank == "AvgFullProfSalary" ~ "Full",
      Rank == "AvgAssocProfSalary" ~ "Assoc",
      Rank == "AvgAssistProfSalary" ~ "Assist"
    )
  )

glimpse(faculty_tidy)
```

```{r}
faculty_tidy <- faculty_tidy %>%
  mutate(Rank = factor(Rank, levels = c("Assist", "Assoc", "Full")))

ggplot(faculty_tidy, aes(x = Rank, y = Salary, fill = Rank)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Tier) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Task 2: ANOVA Model

```{r}
anova_model <- aov(Salary ~ State + Tier + Rank, data = faculty_tidy)

summary(anova_model)
```

## Task 3: Juniper Oils Data

```{r}
juniper <- read_csv("Juniper_Oils.csv")

glimpse(juniper)
```

```{r}
chemicals <- c(
  "alpha-pinene","para-cymene","alpha-terpineol","cedr-9-ene",
  "alpha-cedrene","beta-cedrene","cis-thujopsene","alpha-himachalene",
  "beta-chamigrene","cuparene","compound 1","alpha-chamigrene",
  "widdrol","cedrol","beta-acorenol","alpha-acorenol",
  "gamma-eudesmol","beta-eudesmol","alpha-eudesmol",
  "cedr-8-en-13-ol","cedr-8-en-15-ol","compound 2","thujopsenal"
)

juniper_tidy <- juniper %>%
  select(YearsSinceBurn, all_of(chemicals)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -YearsSinceBurn,
    names_to = "ChemicalID",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  )

glimpse(juniper_tidy)
```

## Task 4:

```{r}
facet_wrap(~ChemicalID, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5)

ggplot(juniper_tidy, aes(x = YearsSinceBurn, y = Concentration)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ChemicalID, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Task 5:

```{r}
library(broom)

model_results <- juniper_tidy %>%
  group_by(ChemicalID) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(Concentration ~ YearsSinceBurn, data = .)))

significant_results <- model_results %>%
  filter(term == "YearsSinceBurn", p.value < 0.05)

significant_results
```
